objective: The Hooks Store, job 11: Builder v2. Rebuild the Builder page to SPEC.md section 3.2 (version 1.41, decision 34) of https://github.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec, using mockup/builder-v2.html in that repository as the visual reference (same colours, fonts, words and prices as the live site; screenshots in mockup/shots/). Layout: two zones, the steps on the left in the order type, how, blocks, settings, and a sticky card on the right (first on phones) that shows the hook as it stands: name and symbol or hook name, pills for type, chain and pair, one colour-swatched tile per rule with the block's short label and its numbers filled in, a "where the money goes" line composed from the fee blocks and the pool fee, a readiness list built from validate() with "fill it in" links that focus the field or open the rule, the cost row with the wait line, CHECK WITH THE SWARM (FREE), CONTINUE TO LAUNCH disabled until ready, and SHOW EXACT TEXT which opens a modal sheet with COPY and CLOSE showing the composed request with the words any open finding points at highlighted. Step 2 carries the starting point (FROM SCRATCH, or FROM MY OWN CODE whose repository and commit fields exist only while it is chosen; the composed text for own code is unchanged) above the DESCRIBE IT | STACK BLOCKS control; the first-visit chooser and the Advanced disclosure in Settings are removed. Step 3 is a category shelf (tabs with swatch and added/total count; block cards with title, blurb and ADD or the state pill; sideways scroll on phones) above the stack, which is one row per rule: number, title, filled-in short label in the mono face, a who-uses-it chip (RUNS ITSELF, OWNER, ANYONE PRESSES), up, down, remove, EDIT; a rule opens to its fields and notes, a newly added block opens, Open all / Close all; the token block is row 0 for type A; the six-block notice stays. Findings: a box under the card with a red stripe, scrolling inside itself at about a third of the screen height, one finding per row (plain title, JUMP TO IT, an excerpt of at most two lines quoting only the words at fault, never a sentence or paragraph); jump focuses the field, opens the rule, or opens the sheet at the highlighted words; pine and "Nothing to fix. The request is consistent." when empty. Sizing: content width capped at 1240 px and centred; two zones at 1100 px and wider (steps minmax(0,1fr), card 420 px); one column with the card first below 1100 px; below 720 px the shelf scrolls sideways and rows wrap their tools; type sizes fixed, never viewport-scaled; every panel min-width 0; addresses and mono text wrap anywhere; no horizontal page scroll at any width from 320 to 2560 px; the card never exceeds the viewport height. Do not change compose(), body(), validate(), checkConsistency(), writtenFees, the relay calls, the free check, the proven-launch line and import, the draft storage key or the launch review page: this job is layout and presentation only, and the unit tests must all still pass unchanged. Rewrite the Playwright tests for the new screen (every step, the card, the findings box, the sheet, the own-code toggle, the shelf on phones, and screenshots at 320, 390, 768, 1100, 1440 and 2560 with no horizontal overflow). Keep the Store, hook page, My hooks, Learn and launch pages as they are. Export the site as before.
